banner.title: Tinokoshesa zvakavanzika zvako
banner.text: Tinoshandisa macookie netekinoroji dzakafanana. Macookie anodiwa anoita kuti webhusaiti ishande. Neruvumbi rwako, tinoshandisawo macookie ekusarudza emabasa, kuongorora nekushambadza. Unogona kugamuchira ose, kuramba ose, kana kusarudza nechikamu, uye kuchinja pfungwa dzako chero nguva.

preferences.title: Zvaunosarudza pamacookie
preferences.text: Sarudza zvikamu zvekusarudza zvaunobvuma. Macookie anodiwa haagone kudzimwa nokuti webhusaiti haishande pasina.

necessary.title: Anodiwa
necessary.description: Anodiwa pamabasa ekutanga akaita sekuchengetedza, kugovera mutoro nekuyeuka sarudzo iyi yemvumo.

functional.title: Anoshanda
functional.description: Anoyeuka zvaunofarira zvakaita sorurimi kana nharaunda uye anobvumira mabasa akasungirirwa.

analytics.title: Kuongorora
analytics.description: Anotibatsira kunzwisisa kuti webhusaiti inoshandiswa sei kuti tiivandudze.

marketing.title: Kushambadza
marketing.description: Anoshandiswa kuyera nekushandura zvishambadziro pawebhusaiti dzakasiyana.

blockedContent: Zvirimo izvi zvakavharirwa kusvikira wabvuma chikamu "{category}".
